status: Arithmetic-reviewed design; not engine-validated or playtested

R.name: Ranger
R.identity: Adult woman with silver-grey hair in a high bun and loose strands; round wire glasses; royal-blue headband with an oval blue gemstone in gold. Royal-blue brocade corset, black lacing and off-shoulder flared black lace sleeves; blue/silver/turquoise necklaces, right-hip satchel and crystal charms, fitted black trousers/lace leggings, grey socks and grey-black combat boots. Use ranger portrait and sheet for design, Jester sheets for pixel style and body scale.
R.weapon: A moonsteel bow folds flat against the back of her corset; necklace beads supply its spare string.

W.name: Herbal Witch
W.identity: Adult woman with long very wavy dark-brown hair, round glasses and a kind smile; drooping wine-red pointed hat with two small cream horns and gold crescent trim. Wine-red robe with large layered gold-trimmed sleeves, black corset and slit tiered skirt, black boots, belt pouch/crystal and crescent pendant. An old brown leather spellbook stays visible in her LEFT hand in every frame; she casts and uses the sickle with her right. Use Witch portrait and sheet for design, Jester sheets for pixel style and body scale.
W.palette: sage green, warm gold and pearl
W.weapon: Her crescent pendant unfolds into a golden harvest sickle.

F.name: Fox
F.identity: Adult woman with curly fluffy shoulder-length light-brown hair, visible pointed fox ears with dark tips, round glasses and a mischievous grin. Pink choker with small gold bell, emerald puffed sleeves/ruffled neckline, red floral brocade corset with black ribbon, wide patchwork TROUSERS gathered at the ankles (skirt-like silhouette), beaded bracelets and brown combat boots. Keep her human face and adult proportions; any extra tails are spectral spell effects. Use Fox portrait and sheet for design, Jester sheets for pixel style and body scale.
F.palette: cold blue foxfire with occasional amber glints
F.weapon: Dressmaker shears separate into twin daggers; sewn-in needles become darts.

J.name: Jester
J.identity: Adult-proportioned Jester in the two supplied pixel-art style sheets: black curved horns with pom-poms, burgundy veil and layered dress, purple patterned leggings, heavy black boots, turquoise pendant and gold hip bells. Use these sheets directly for pixel density, outlines, shading, scale and casting viewpoint; the group concept is secondary for identity detail.
J.palette: violet, black-violet, restrained silver and turquoise
J.weapon: Gold hip bells unfold into the head of a concealed chain flail.

moves.name: Moonsteel Draw
moves.effect: Free weapon attack: 1.0P physical damage.

moves.name: Silver Arrow
moves.effect: 2.0M light damage.
frames: Arrow concentrates to a white point

moves.name: Lantern Flare
moves.effect: 0.6M light damage each; reveal stealth for 12s; Dazzle reduces direct damage dealt by 20% for 6s. Boss damage reduction is 10%.
frames: Flare opens into a broad fan

moves.name: Crescent Volley
moves.effect: Three bolts, each 1.0M light damage. Bolts may share a target; total damage is 3.0M, not 3.0M per enemy.
frames: A second arrow fans beside it
Three strings of light pull taut

moves.name: Silverglass Ward
moves.effect: Shield of 3.0M for 8s; subject to global shield limits.
frames: Free hand draws a short arc
Arc becomes a pane of silver glass

moves.name: Guiding Star
moves.effect: For 8s, incoming damage receives +20% additive vulnerability; this mark can add at most 400 total HP damage before ending. No bonus to Doom, Gravity or reflected damage. Does not stack with itself.
frames: Thin light thread leaves her fingers

moves.name: Moonlit Passage
moves.effect: Each ally evades their next eligible direct enemy hit within 5s. Does not evade ground hazards, damage-over-time or explicitly unavoidable attacks. Each charge is consumed once; a multi-hit action loses only one hit.
frames: One boot traces a silver line
Silver line opens into a path
Cloak and hair lift toward path
Passage grants each ally an evasion charge

moves.name: Pin the Shadow
moves.effect: 1.2M light damage and 4s Root; anchored bosses receive 1s Root. Root stops movement, not casting or attacks.

moves.name: Beacon’s Mercy
moves.effect: Heal 2.0H and remove one removable negative status; prioritize Doom, then hard control, then damage-over-time.
frames: Both hands cup a little light

moves.name: Full Moon Ascendant
moves.target: Up to four enemies and all four allies
moves.effect: Ultimate, once per encounter. 4.0M light damage per enemy; shield every living ally for 1.5M for 8s.
frames: Silver threads climb from her jewel
Threads curve into a lunar disc
She draws an enormous light arrow
Arrow breaks into a moonlit rain
Moon fades and she lowers bow

moves.name: Harvest Crescent
moves.effect: Free weapon attack: 0.8P physical damage.
frames: Body turns into a low guard

moves.name: Silverleaf Salve
moves.effect: Heal 2.4H.
frames: Open book stays in left hand at waist
Right fingers select a dried leaf
Book and hand return to ready

moves.name: Moondew
moves.effect: Heal 0.5H at 2,4,6,8,10,12s after release: total 3.0H. Same-caster refresh replaces remaining ticks; no immediate tick.
frames: Book stays in left hand as right hand lifts a small bottle
A bead of dew floats upward

moves.name: Thornwake
moves.effect: 1.6M nature damage and 3s Root; anchored bosses receive 1s Root.
frames: A seed glows beside her boot
Thorn tips rise in a narrow line

moves.name: Bitter Remedy
moves.effect: Heal 0.8H and cleanse up to two removable negative statuses using the shared priority order.
frames: Dark herb is pinched between fingers
Herb crumbles over a tiny cup
She swirls vapour into a spiral

moves.name: Bramble Cradle
moves.effect: Shield each ally for 1.5H for 10s.
frames: Left hand holds closed book against chest
Right palm lowers toward the earth
Four bramble shields bloom around allies
Right hand opens to release the shields

moves.name: Elderwood Guardian
moves.effect: Summon for 15s, HP 5.0H. It intercepts at most three single-target direct hits against allies and attacks the selected enemy for 0.6M at 3,6,9,12,15s after summon. Redirect overflow reaches the original ally. One shared Witch summon slot.
frames: A large seed rests on her right palm above the left-held book
She lays seed on open book
Bark face and branch antlers emerge
Right hand rests briefly against the guardian arm; left hand retains book

moves.name: Sailwing Moth
moves.effect: Summon for 15s, HP 3.0H. Heal the living ally with lowest HP percentage for 0.6H at 3,6,9,12,15s. Party takes 10% less area damage while it lives. Does not intercept attacks. Shares Witch summon slot.
frames: Right hand touches crescent pendant while left hand holds book
A small cocoon appears above book
Moth lifts free with a shower of pollen
Right hand guides the first wingbeat; book stays in left hand

moves.name: Rootbound Return
moves.effect: Revive at 30% maximum HP. Each ally may receive this revive only once per encounter. Clears removable debuffs; recipient cannot act for 2s and is not invulnerable. No effect on story deaths.
frames: She kneels with the open book still held in her left hand
A seed glows on her right palm above the pages
A bright pulse passes through the roots
Roots lift ally back to life
Flowers scatter as she rises with book in left hand

moves.name: Garden Beneath the Moon
moves.target: All living allies and up to four enemies
moves.effect: Ultimate, once per encounter. Heal each living ally for 2.0H immediately, then six ticks of H/3 at 2s intervals: 2.0H more over 12s. Root enemies 3s; anchored bosses 1s. Does not revive.
frames: Left hand opens book wide and pages lift
Right hand scatters a handful of seeds
A pale moon illuminates the garden
Pollen and vines settle into a healing field
She lowers her right hand beneath petals while left hand retains book

moves.name: Hemline Fangs
moves.effect: Free weapon attack: two hits of 0.5P each; 1.0P total.
frames: Fingers find shears at patchwork trouser seam
Shears lift with a playful flourish
Daggers spin back into her palms

moves.name: Blue Mischief
moves.effect: 2.0M cold foxfire damage. It harms only its designated target.
frames: A blue spark skips onto fingertip
Spark becomes a small fox-shaped flame
She balances it above her palm
Flame crouches as though ready to leap
She waves after it with a grin

moves.name: Borrowed Face
moves.effect: Create one decoy for 6s with a total 2.0M HP budget. It redirects at most two eligible single-target hits aimed at Fox. Overflow damages Fox; no copied attacks or extra turns.
frames: A second smile appears beside her
Decoy settles in front of her
Real Fox slips one step behind

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.effect: Swap an ally and an ordinary enemy between their formation slots and cancel one ordinary enemy windup aimed at that ally. Against anchored bosses, move ally between allied ranks and grant one direct-hit evasion charge for 4s; do not move boss or cancel its windup. No cooldown reset.
frames: She looks from ally to enemy

moves.name: Finders Keepers
moves.target: One enemy; self receives stolen buff
moves.effect: Steal the oldest eligible positive buff for its remaining duration, capped at 10s. Excludes phase mechanics, invulnerability, summons, shields and unique boss effects. With no eligible buff, deal 1.0M foxfire damage instead; never both.
frames: She reels it in with two fingers

moves.name: Loose Thread
moves.effect: Three damage ticks of 0.65M at 3,6,9s: total 1.95M. Target deals 15% less direct damage for the first 6s; anchored bosses receive 7.5% reduction.
frames: A needle slides from patchwork trouser hem
Thread turns blue between her hands
Needle loops through a tiny knot
Needle sends the knot to target

moves.name: Ninefold Lie
moves.effect: Three successive waves each deal 0.8M per enemy; total 2.4M per enemy. Nine visible images are cosmetic and do not add nine extra hits.
frames: She lifts a fold of her wide patchwork trousers
Three become nine in a curved fan
Nine figures mirror one mischievous gesture
Reflections collapse into the real Fox

moves.name: Bellbound Bargain
moves.effect: Ally gains +25% M for 10s. Fox pays ceil(15% of her maximum HP) on release, bypassing shields; cannot cast if this would leave her below 1 HP. No MP transfer. Bonus adds to other M buffs, with total M bonus capped at +50%.
frames: She cradles bell in both hands
Bell lifts clear of her throat
A gold-blue thread joins an ally
Thread glows as the bargain seals
Light travels from bell to ally

moves.name: When the Bell Falls Silent
moves.effect: For 12s gain +30% M and +20% physical weapon-attack damage. Bell falls silent and spectral fox tails appear. No instant attack; no time stop. Same buff cannot stack.
frames: She rests two fingers on bell
Smile settles into a calm expression
Spectral tails open in a broad fan
Silent foxfire mantle locks into place
She lowers hand without a jingle
Return to a composed ready stance

moves.name: The Moon’s Little Lie
moves.target: Up to four enemies and all living allies
moves.effect: Ultimate, once per encounter. 5.0M foxfire damage per enemy. Each ally receives one decoy for 6s; each has M HP and redirects only one eligible direct hit, with overflow reaching ally. Replaces weaker decoys on same ally.
frames: She points up with an amused glance
A tiny crescent balances on her finger
Crescent spins like a tossed coin
Spectral tails sweep across the sky
Crescent becomes an impossible blue moon
Moon splits into foxfire and four doubles
Crescent vanishes into bell as stance resets

moves.name: Gilded Rebuke
moves.effect: Free weapon attack: 0.9P physical damage.
frames: One bell drops onto a fine chain
Wrist turns in a small courtly flourish

moves.name: Ill Omen
moves.effect: 0.8M fate damage. Affordable lesser spell; does not place Doom.
frames: Spark curls into a crooked star

moves.name: Sealed Fate
moves.effect: Apply one Doom mark for 20s, maximum three active marks across enemies; reapplication refreshes rather than stacks. At expiry an ordinary enemy dies. Anchored boss instead loses min(10% phase-maximum HP, 5.0M). Mark remembers phase and M at application. Boss loss bypasses shields and damage modifiers. No impact damage.
frames: A violet secret emerges like a thread
Thread winds around a dark orb
Orb develops a fine circular sigil
Sigil closes onto target and starts Doom
Fingers close over the spent secret

moves.name: Hush
moves.effect: Silence an ordinary enemy for 6s and cancel one interruptible magic windup. Anchored boss instead has its current interruptible magic cast extended by 1.5s, without silence or cancellation. No damage.
frames: One finger rises toward her lips
Ring closes around an imagined mouth
She fixes target with a steady look
Ring thins into a dark thread

moves.name: Stop
moves.effect: Freeze an ordinary enemy for 3s; anchored boss for 1s. Pauses its action/movement progress, not global time, cooldowns, status durations or Doom. Uninterruptible scripted actions are explicitly excluded.
frames: A violet ring rotates over it
Fine clocklike spokes appear without numerals
Ring and her gaze become completely still

moves.name: Gravity
moves.effect: Lose min(25% current HP, 4.0M), leaving at least 1 HP. Bypasses shields and modifiers, cannot crit and does not receive Guiding Star. Bosses use the same capped formula.
frames: Bead grows into a dark sphere
Silver light bends around its edge
She lowers palm and target gravity collapses inward

moves.name: Royal Reversal
moves.effect: For 8s intercept the next removable negative status application against ally. Block it and attempt to apply that status once to its source under normal boss/control rules. Never reflect damage, Doom, other reflected effects, phase effects or unavoidable mechanics. Consumed even if source is immune.
frames: Two fingers lift an edge of veil
She offers a shallow courtly bow
Mirror turns its dark face outward
An inverted crescent lights its frame
Mirror floats into place beside ally
She straightens with a slight smile

moves.name: Against All Odds
moves.effect: Over 12s heal each ally for six ticks of H/6 (total 1.0H), plus 15% Haste. If mean HP fraction of living allies is at or below 40% at release: total heal becomes 2.0H and Haste 25%. Haste affects recovery only, not casting, cooldowns, summons, DoT or Doom.
frames: She looks upward with hands apart
A faint violet ring forms above her
Small lights hang like unlikely stars
Stars align into a narrow path overhead
She turns the alignment toward the party
Hands lower beneath the remaining glow

moves.name: The Last Toll
moves.effect: 4.0M fate damage. One deep bell note accompanies impact. Does not trigger or consume Doom.
frames: Hand closes around one hip bell
Chain lifts bell in front of her
Bell hangs still at the centre of a dark halo
Bell swings once and releases a heavy pulse
Halo breaks into falling silver dust
Chain gathers back and stance resets

moves.name: Curtain Call
moves.target: Up to four enemies; all living allies
moves.effect: Ultimate, once per encounter. First resolve all active Doom marks immediately, consuming each once; then deal 2.0M fate damage to each surviving selected enemy. Shield each living ally for 0.75M for 6s. No damage to corpses; no second Doom trigger.
frames: She places one hand over pendant
A circular seal opens before her chest
She extends arms as veil and skirts lift
Sigils align and every surrounding mote becomes still
Hands close and all Doom seals resolve
A ring of silver-violet sparks wards the party
She lowers her hands in a small final bow

art_direction.rendering: 16-bit JRPG HD-2D pixel sprite style matching supplied Jester sheets; adult proportions, not chibi

base_generation.shadow: soft oval ground shadow as in supplied prompts

combat_template.pose_anchor: match actual Jester body height and measured foot baseline; do not normalize to hat tips
combat_template.background: #393144 for generation masters; alpha extraction later
combat_template.walk_view: side, facing right as supplied base prompts

notes: New pack contains six concept crops and two pixel Jester style sheets, not finished Ranger/Witch/Fox base sprite sheets.
60 figures on three requested base sheets are production work, not automatically 60 additional unique runtime frames.
320 combat keyframes remain the gross target; reuse is credited only after inspection.
